title: K-Pop Demon Hunters Rumi 4in Collectible Figure, Netflix - New
descriptionText: The product is a 4-inch collectible action figure of the character Rumi from the Netflix series "K-pop Demon Hunters". This figure is part of the franchise and features the artist Rumi. It is a must-have item for fans of the show and collectors of action figures. With detailed craftsmanship and accuracy in design, this collectible is sure to be a prized possession for any enthusiast of the series.
